title: Generate a DKIM key
description: Install the DKIM key of a sending domain: generate it, use the key at the shared OpenBao path, import a PEM key, or copy the key of a kumomta peer. Clustered, an existing shared key is never replaced

rotate.description: Replace the current key with a new one

source.description: generate (default), shared (the key at the OpenBao path), import (private_key) or peer (the key of the kumomta instance peer)

private_key.description: With import: PEM private key. Never returned

peer.description: With peer: module ID of the kumomta instance
